Name: Standard Farm Map Without Small Pond (Content Patcher Compatible)
Author: iAmTheTot
Description:
I searched and searched but I could not find a standard farm map that only had the small pond removed. I could find some with the big one removed, or both removed, but not just the small one. So I dedicated an afternoon to learning how to do it myself.

To install Content Patcher version:
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip [i][CP] Standard Farm wo Small Pond[/i] into your [i]Stardew Valley\Mods [/i]folder. This is often [i]C:\SteamLibrary\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i].
[*]That's it! You're done. The pond has been replaced with plain dirt.
[/list]
[b][i]The instructions below are for the OLD file version. Only follow these if downloading the Old File.[/i][/b]
To install non-Content Patcher version:
[list]
[*]This method is not recommended. It requires actually replacing game files, which always carries certain risks. 
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley folder. This is often [i]C:\SteamLibrary\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley[/i]
[*]Open the Content folder, then the Maps folder.
[*]Find "Farm.xnb" and BACK IT UP somewhere. You can simply rename the file Farm.xnb.bak, for example.
[*]Download my Farm.xnb file from the files page, and place it into this folder.
[*]That's it, you're done! The pond has been replaced with plain dirt.
[/list]
